w:r.w:t: Home page par jo search bar lga h, use change karna hai. Abhi usme do option choose venue or choose location aa rhe hai isme 1 option or add karna hai. Or jab bhi user koi Venue/coach/trainer search karega too total registered profile ka result count btana hai
Search karte time hame user ko trending searches bhi dikhana like this
Yha pr sequence change karna hai: first no pr select venues, second no pr select coach, and third no pr select trainer ayega

Yha pr top rated venues/coaches/trainer 3no ek sath ayege or jo slider lga h use vertical lgana h or niche show more ka button lgana h jisse wo particular category ke page pr phuch jaye

Page pr price, size and new/old se sort karne ka fillter bhi lganaa hai

Turf owner ko profile update karte time venue ka image ke sath video upload karne ka option dena hai, aur venue page pe venue ki profile share karne ka bhi option dena hai. Or sath me multiple sports yadi provide karte h to uski details add karne ka option dena hai.
Venue listing/coach/trainer page par bhi image ke sath video upload karne ka option dena hai.
Sabhi deshbord pr multiple category select karne ka option dena hai or sare field editable bnana hai.
Super admin ke pass sarii chijo ka editable access hona chiye.
Coach ke page pr jha sari listings show hogi 2-3 listing in a row, wha pr image ke sath review rating, specialization, hourly rate, and age dikhana hai.
Is page pr filter me ye ayega. Sort by(on top)

Coach/Trainer profile bnate time ye bhi update karega ki wo kon kon se level ke bando ko coaching dena chata hai or apna bhi level btayega like beginner/Intermediate/Advanced or response time bhi btayega ki kitne time me enquiry response krega
Coach or Trainer booking ke time par ek disclaimer dena hai ki agar huamre platform k alawa or kahi se ya direct book krta hai to uski jimmedari humari nahi hogi
Language knows k field add karni hai.
Class location k field add karna hai.
Kitne student ko train kar chuke h wo add karna hai.
Responding time ka option add karna hai.
Book now wale page ke button ke pahle package add karn hai.
Daily ki availability ka time add karne ka option dena hai.
Coach or trainer ki profile kitne logo ne dekhi h wo count show karwana h unki profile page pr or listing page pr.
Jab coach or trainer apna registration karega
par to uske bad uske paas ek mail or msg par profile complete karne ke liye link jayega.
Coach or trainer ko apni profile share karne ka option bhi dena hai. Aur jab wo profile kisi ke sath share kare, to usme unke contact no or address hide hone chiye.
Profile me trainer ya coach ko unki social profile add karne ka option bhi dena hai. Sath me image or video add karne ka bhi option dena hai.
Bina activity ke 15 min k baad automatic profile logout ho jana chahiye
Booking payment ke time hame 2 option dena hai
Partial payment refundable nahi rahega, aur full payment me, yadi user apne booking time se 4hr pahle cancel krega to 25% payment deduct hoke payment refund ho jayega.
Venue admin ko ek CRM bna ke dena hai jisme wo uske pass direct ane wali booking ki details manually bhi hmari site pr add kar sake.
Sabhi dashboard pr stats pie chart or graphs lgane hai for total booking, total revenue or isme filter bhi lgana h day/week/month/custom wala or report download kane ka option bhi dena hai
